threats.title: Forged payment webhook marks invoices paid
Tenant reads another tenant's invoice PDF by changing the id

guardrails.title: Webhook signatures verified before any state change

requirements.title: Unsigned payment webhooks change nothing
requirements.statement: The system shall reject a payment webhook whose signature does not verify against the tenant's signing secret, and leave the invoice unchanged.

acceptance.negative: Missing or wrong signature returns 401, writes a Suspicious audit row with rule G-01, invoice unchanged.
acceptance.positiveControl: A correctly signed webhook marks the invoice paid.

requirements.title: Output encoding of tenant text in invoice HTML
requirements.statement: The system shall render every tenant-supplied string in invoice HTML as text, never as markup.

acceptance.negative: A rendered invoice built from a corpus of markup payloads contains none of them as live elements.
acceptance.positiveControl: Ordinary text, including &, < and quotes, renders as written.
